talents.name: Aeroboard
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: A hover board that helps you travel faster and does not cost stamina. Can be used in Astra.

talents.name: Elemental Boost
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Increases elemental counter effect by 3/6/9/12%.

talents.name: Enhanced Twining
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Increases Aniimo damage after twining by 10/13/16/20/25%.

recommended.reason: Enhanced Twining increases aniimo damage after twining by a certain percentage. You will likely use Twining in most scenarios such as enemy encounters and boss fights, so having increased damage allows you to defeat enemies faster.

talents.name: Heal
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: You sprinkle healing dust on the engaged Aniimo to restore its HP.

recommended.reason: Heal is an active skill that lets you restore the HP of the Aniimo. It is one of the first skills you can unlock and comes in handy when using Command Mode in combat.

talents.name: Master Trainer
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Aniimo EXP gained from catching and defeating targets or using EXP items increases by 10/15/20/30%.

recommended.reason: Master Trainer is a passive skill that increases the amount of experience you gained from catching aniimo, defeating enemies, and using experience gems by a certain percentage. Unlocking this skill is recommended to level up faster and unlock now skills.

talents.name: Mode Switch
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Enables switching between Catch Mode, Attack Mode, and Defensive Mode.

talents.name: Pro Catcher
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Unlocks Aniipod Pro in the shop.

talents.name: Swoleshroom
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: A newly developed energy mushroom. Feed it to the active Aniimo to increase its size and attack range, and increase damage taken by enemies by 20%.

talents.name: Boss Breaker
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Increases damage to Alpha and Omega by 5%.

talents.name: Dreamsong
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Dreaple’s exceptional evolution unlocked.

talents.name: Gravity Pull
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Activates the target’s energy field to create a gravity link. Move objects with ancient energy patterns from a distance. Essential for solving puzzles in ancient ruins.

talents.name: Mega Mallet
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Smash the targets within a circular area in front with a huge energy hammer, dealing a large amount of BREAK damage. It can also smash solid objects.

recommended.reason: Mega Mallet allows your Pathfinder to smash solid objects and deal a large amount of Break damage within a circular target. This is one of the most recommended skill as it allows your player character to deal damage to enemies while also commanding your aniimo to fight in combat.

talents.name: Elemental Ward
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Increases element resistance effect by 3/6/9/12%.

talents.name: Magical Horn
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Unlocks Tromber’s exceptional evolution.

talents.name: Master Catcher
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Unlocks purchasing Aniipod Megas, Aniipod Hypers, Aniipod Traces, and Tumblers at shops.

talents.name: Plushie Pummel
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: You spin around and wave the doll like crazy, dealing BREAK damage to targets in your path and smashing hard objects.

talents.name: Tweetin' Target
talents.title: Student
talents.desc: Consumes 1 rubber duck and throw it at the target area to draw the attention of all Aniimo in a non-combat state in range for 10s.

recommended.reason: Tweetin' Target lets you throw a yellow rubber duck on the ground to attract an aniimo when not in combat. If you prefer a stealth approach when catching aniimo, unlocking this skill is recommended as it lets you obtain stealth catch bonuses easier.

talents.name: Bubble Gun
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Prevents the target Aniimo from being Fainted. While the effect is active, its HP cannot drop below 1, allowing it to be caught multiple times in battle.

recommended.reason: Bubble Gun lets you use a bottle of vigor bubbles towards a targeted aniimo to prevent them from fainting. The HP of the targeted aniimo will remain above 1, allowing you to make multiple catch attempts.

talents.name: Nimble Dodge
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Reduces stamina cost for dodging by 10%.

talents.name: Research Expert
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Reporting grants 10/15/20/30% more Credits.

talents.name: Revive
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Allows you to revive Aniimo in your roster.

talents.name: Peculiar Rock Ball
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Unlocks Bouldus’s exceptional evolution.

talents.name: Quick Twine
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Amplifies your mind power and reduces the time needed to twine with an Aniimo to a mere instant.

recommended.reason: Quick Twine is a combat skill that lets you instantly twine with an aniimo. By default, it takes a few seconds to switch from Pathfinder to Aniimo. Unlocking this skill makes the switch instant, allowing you to do this while in the middle of combat.

talents.name: Go! Rubber Duck!
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Consumes 1 Giant Rubber Duck and throw it at the target area, drawing the attention of all out-of-combat Aniimo within a large area for 20s.

talents.name: Measured Strike
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Aniimo deals 10% increased damage to targets in BREAK state.

talents.name: Sure Shot
talents.title: Wayfarer
talents.desc: Greatly increases Aniipod's targeting range.

talents.name: Fast Charge
talents.title: Trailblazer
talents.desc: Increases the charging speed of Aniimo ultimates by 10%.

talents.name: Unwavering Rampart
talents.title: Trailblazer
talents.desc: Unlocks Rookey’s exceptional evolution.
